map.由流量、扬程与效率，按 P = ρgQH/η 计算水泵轴功率（输入功率）。: Compute pump shaft (input) power by P = rho*g*Q*H/eta from fluid density, gravity, flow, head and efficiency.
map.轴功率=水力功率/效率；η 越低成本越高。: Shaft power = hydraulic power / efficiency; lower η means higher cost.
map.按流量、扬程、效率算轴功率配电机。: Compute shaft power and size motor by flow, head and efficiency.
map.变频运行按工况点重算功率。: VFD operation recomputes power at the operating point.
map.总能耗与运行成本估算。: Total energy use and operating cost estimate.
map.η 0.7→0.82，同参数功率降到约 12.0 kW，高效泵长期省电。: η 0.7→0.82 lowers power to about 12.0 kW at the same params; high-efficiency pump saves power long term.
map.轴功率是水力/η，电机配套再乘 1.1~1.2 余量并核启动。: Shaft power is hydraulic/η; motor matching multiplies by 1.1~1.2 margin and checks starting.
map.泵常年运行，效率差几个点年电费差可观，选型与维护都要抓。: Pumps run year round; a few efficiency points mean a large annual cost gap, so both selection and maintenance matter.
